# P37.10 — Asset-promotion gate (PUB-012)

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/431_P37.10__asset-promotion-gate.md` (manifest row 431, R11-DATA-06)
**Stack:** on `r11/P37.9-lifecycle-into-dossier-timeline` · **Harness:** devin-desktop/swe-2-high/subagent

The §43.5 asset-promotion rule had no home (F2a NEW-2: the BL-009 split-out gate was never wired — "satisfied only vacuously (nothing promotes)"). This lands `policy.promotion`: `promotion_permitted()` is the only gate on the candidate→`PhysicalAsset` write path and `promotion_claims()` the only writer — a corroboration-only candidate is refused with a named refusal, never silently dropped.

## What landed

- `policy/src/policy/promotion.py` — the gate. `ConfirmationKind` carries exactly the three admissible §43.5 classes (`field`/`imagery`/`documentary`) — corroboration is not a member by construction, so `observation_count`/the `corroborated` status can never masquerade as confirmation. Each `Confirmation` must carry its actor or document reference (the §3.1 defining standard: `unprovenanced_confirmation` refuses otherwise). `promotion_permitted()` returns the `PromotionDecision` with every refusal named from a closed vocabulary (`residential_parcel` — SIG-PUB-013 holds even with confirmation; `corroboration_only`; `decided`; `already_promoted`; `unprovenanced_confirmation`; `unknown_status`; `missing_subject`). `promotion_claims()` is the only writer: it mints the promoted asset's claim set (`asset_exists_at_location` + `fixed_asset_location` on the `promoted:` subject, `candidate_promotion_status = promoted` on the candidate) only behind a permitted decision and raises `PromotionRefused` otherwise; the `PromotionWrite` carries a private gate token — it cannot be fabricated without the gate.
- `db/src/db/data/subject_entity_types.toml` (map 1.0.0 → 1.1.0) — `candidate:` subjects mint `candidate_asset` (SIG-ONTO-029, the separate type candidates must live in); `promoted:` subjects mint `physical_asset`. A new promotion path is a deliberate map edit, never a silent sink default (fail-closed unchanged).
- Tests — `tests/unit/test_policy_promotion.py` (15: the corroboration-only refusal acceptance shape, all permitted kinds + precedence, every refusal, the only-writer token) and `tests/db/test_asset_promotion.py` (4, real PG18+PostGIS: a permitted write mints `physical_asset` + lands the status flip; the write is append-only +0 on replay; a corroboration-only candidate writes nothing).
